name: Solesence Inc. Common Stock
summary: Solesence, Inc., formerly known as Nanophase Technologies Corporation, specializes in the development and production of clean-label, inclusive, and mineral-based skincare and cosmetic products. The company collaborates with a diverse range of partners, from major global corporations to independent brands, employing its unique Active Stress Defense™ technology suite. Through this proprietary system, Solesence brings innovative beauty solutions to the market that provide effective environmental protection.
